issues.what: The framing 'as the two judges left it' / 'both judges' fixes' is overstated. Judge 1's condition was to gate only where the H2 counts are not already the regime cluster; the study applied it per model, not per column, and gated on hmm3 state 0 (= hmm3_p0, cluster 3), gmm4 state 1 (= gmm4_p1, cluster 3) and jump4_state (cluster 3), all in the n_choch_since_bos cluster. Judge 2's precondition (fit HMM / jump only if the GMM state already beats n_choch_since_bos at matched skip fraction on CV) was not applied: gmm4's nested diff -108.90 does not beat the matched H2 cell 257.83, yet the HMM and jump gates were run. The design's leakage control 'parameters and z-scoring estimated on training-fold bars only, refit per fold' was replaced by the frozen fit-window (2021-10..2023-09) models (label-free, acknowledged in caveats). Every extra configuration is a counted ledger row and the result is null, so no hidden multiplicity or false positive follows; the deviation only adds trials and mis-describes adherence.
